citations.claim: PluralClient class serves as the main HTTP client implementing the Open States API v3 interface
Base URL points to Open States API v3 at https://v3.openstates.org
API key management integrates with centaur_sdk.secret for secure credential handling
Centralized request handling with automatic authentication and structured error handling
Jurisdictions API supports listing and filtering of states, territories, and municipalities
People API provides comprehensive legislator search with jurisdiction, name, and role filtering
Geolocation-based legislator lookup using latitude and longitude coordinates
Bills API supports comprehensive search with full-text queries, date filters, and sponsor lookup
Committees API provides jurisdiction-based committee listing with chamber filtering
Events API enables legislative event retrieval with date range and bill association filtering
CLI built with Typer framework providing rich command-line interface
Jurisdictions command provides tabular output with jurisdiction data
People command enables legislator search with rich table formatting
External dependencies include httpx for HTTP client, typer for CLI, and rich for formatting
Centaur configuration specifies API key secrets management for Open States API
Integration with httpx for HTTP client and centaur_sdk for secret management
CLI uses typer for command parsing and rich for console output formatting
Context manager support for proper resource cleanup of HTTP connections
Factory function provides convenient client instantiation
Configuration requires PLURAL_API_KEY from open.pluralpolicy.com
